As a consequence we deduce from the material in
`Mathlib.Topology.Category.CompHausLike.EffectiveEpi` that `LightProfinite` is `Preregular`
and `Precoherent`.
-/

namespace LightProfinite

  rw [← epi_iff_surjective]
  infer_instance
